blurb: Brooklyn Sail offers 2.5 hour private and group sailing tours as well as sailing lessons on a 34' Catalina sailboat named Enchantress. Guests sail around New York Harbor with views of landmarks like the Brooklyn Bridge and Statue of Liberty. The boat has a large deck, cabin, working bathroom, Bluetooth speakers, and refrigeration.
extraNote: Passengers may bring any food or drink except red wine or anything messy or staining · Pier 5 in Brooklyn Bridge Park, One15 Brooklyn Marina, 159 Bridge Park Dr.
